nodes.description: Public function that loops over a caller-supplied Call[] array and performs an arbitrary low-level external call to each target with attacker-chosen calldata.
Public view helper returning the ETH balance of the supplied address.
Public view helper returning blockhash(blockNumber) for the caller-supplied block number.
Public view helper returning blockhash(block.number - 1).
Public view helper exposing the current block timestamp.
Public view helper exposing the current block difficulty.
Public view helper exposing the current block gas limit.
Public view helper exposing the current block coinbase.
Miner-influenceable block timestamp read inside getCurrentBlockTimestamp.
Unchecked low-level .call on an arbitrary target address with arbitrary calldata, executed inside a loop; external call before state effects is reentrancy-prone.
Caller-supplied Call[] memory array of target addresses and calldata payloads.
Caller-supplied address whose balance is queried.
Caller-supplied block number passed to blockhash().
Local return value assigned block.number inside aggregate.
Local bytes[] array of return payloads for successful calls.
Loop index iterating over the calls array.
Local bytes32 assigned the result of blockhash(blockNumber).
Local uint256 assigned block.timestamp and returned.
Local uint256 assigned addr.balance and returned.
Local bool result of the low-level call.
Local bytes return payload of the low-level call.

edges.reason: aggregate executes the unchecked low-level external call inside its loop body.
Attacker-controlled target and callData from the calls parameter flow directly into the low-level .call, enabling arbitrary external invocation and reentrancy.
aggregate assigns block.number to the local blockNumber return variable.
aggregate allocates and writes the local returnData array.
aggregate uses i as its loop counter over the calls array.
aggregate stores the low-level call success flag in the local success variable.
aggregate stores the low-level call return bytes in the local ret variable.
The loop bound of i is derived from calls.length.
getCurrentBlockTimestamp reads and returns the miner-controllable block.timestamp, creating timestamp dependency.
getCurrentBlockTimestamp assigns block.timestamp to its local timestamp variable.
block.timestamp flows into the returned local timestamp value.
getEthBalance stores addr.balance in the local balance variable.
The addr parameter is the subject of the balance read in getEthBalance.
getBlockHash assigns blockhash(blockNumber) to the local blockHash variable.
The blockNumber parameter is consumed by blockhash() and flows into the local blockHash result.

normalization_plan.reason: The Call[] memory parameter is only meaningful within aggregate; merge it into the enclosing function node.
The addr parameter exists solely as input to getEthBalance and should be collapsed into it.
The blockNumber parameter is used only by getBlockHash and should be merged into that function node.
Local return variable assigned block.number inside aggregate; absorb into the function node.
Local bytes[] buffer used only inside aggregate's loop; absorb into the function node.
Local loop counter scoped to aggregate; absorb into the function node.
Local result of blockhash() inside getBlockHash; absorb into the function node.
Local mirror of block.timestamp returned by getCurrentBlockTimestamp; absorb into the function node.
Local balance read inside getEthBalance; absorb into the function node.
Success flag is the direct result of the low-level call operation and should merge into that unsafe operation node.
Returned bytes are the direct output of the low-level call operation and should merge into that unsafe operation node.
